defs: adj	Done with intensity or to a great degree; thorough.
adj	Making something more intense; intensifying.
adj	(agriculture, economics) Of agriculture: increasing the productivity of an area of land.
adj	(linguistics) Of a word: serving to give emphasis or force.
adj	Involving much activity in a short period of time; highly concentrated.
adj	Of or pertaining to innate or internal intensity or strength rather than outward extent.
adj	Chiefly suffixed to a noun: using something with intensity; requiring a great amount of something; demanding.
adj	(medicine) Chiefly in intensive care: of care or treatment: involving a great degree of life support, monitoring, and other forms of effort in order to manage life-threatening conditions.
n	A thing which makes something more intense; specifically (linguistics), a form of a word with a more forceful or stronger sense than the root on which it is built.
n	(education) A course taught intensively, involving much activity in a short period of time.
adj	(obsolete) That can be intensified; allowing an increase of degree.
adj	(obsolete) Synonym of intense (“extreme or very high or strong in degree; of feelings, thoughts, etc.: strongly focused”).
adj	Intent (of the mind, thoughts etc.).
adj	Tending to excite, provoke or stir up emotions; inflammatory.
